title: Luxurious 2BR Rosemary Beach Condo with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Stay in this 2BR, 2BA vacation condo in Rosemary Beach overlooking a park, with easy access to the beach and the Cabana pool and tennis courts. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Located on St. Augustine Park- Professionally designed- Close to the Cabana Pool- High-speed Wifi- 2 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes- 7-8 Minute Walk to the Beach- 2-6 Minute walk to 4 Private Community PoolsRecently re-designed to reflect the calming, neutral colors of the sea, Just Breathe Flat is a refined coastal condominium with a polished and luxurious feel. Overlooking the vibrant green of a local park, guests of Just Breath Flat will also have easy access to the beach access point, the Cabana swimming pool, the tennis courts, and the charming downtown. With two bedrooms and just under 1,000 square feet of living space, this home is perfect for those looking to truly relax and recharge in Rosemary Beach.Located within an exclusive complex that is perched on the bright green lawn of St. Augustine Park, Just Breathe Flat is located one flight up. When you enter this inviting space, you’re welcomed by a soothing neutral palette that blends sandy neutrals with crisp whites and pops of calming blues. A dining space for six people leads into the living area— where two comfy sofas and driftwood-inspired furnishings face a large HDTV. Lots of windows and glass doors let the bright squares of sunlight inside and lead out to the patio that overlooks the gorgeous park that’s just across the street.Back inside, a peninsula bar of Santa Cecilia granite has casual stool seating and leads into the open, galley-style kitchen. A full suite of stainless steel appliances includes an electric range and oven, a large refrigerator, a dishwasher, and a microwave with a vent hood. Pristine white cabinets provide plenty of storage space.Down the hallway is the primary bedroom suite, complete with a premier king-size bed set in a chic upholstered frame that’s flanked with bedside tables. This private and plush room also includes a navy blue armchair, rustic dresser, and a large HDTV. The ensuite bathroom features a double vanity, garden tub, and step-in shower. In the second bedroom, there are two custom twin-over-twin size built-in bunk beds with sleeping space for four and an HDTV. An additional full bathroom has a tub/shower combo.Tucked among the swaying trees and charming cobblestoned street of Rosemary Beach, Just Breathe Flat boasts an idyllic location that places you front-and-center to all of the surrounding 30A magic. You’ll be steps away from St. Augustine Park, the Cabana pool, the heated indoor Sky pool, a fully-equipped fitness center, and the tennis courts. You’ll be able to stroll to a lazy afternoon spent on the sand, followed by a delicious dinner that evening at one of the many restaurants just around the corner. It’s all here, waiting for you to arrive, Just Breathe, and truly relax.MAIN LEVEL:LIVING AREA w/ two couches, sleeper sofa, HDTV (Sleeps 2)DINING SPACE w/ seating for sixOutdoor TERRACE w/ lounging and dining spacePRIMARY SUITE w/ king-size bed and ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)GUEST BEDROOM w/ 2 twin-over-twin bunks (Sleeps 4)FULL BATHROOM w/ tub/shower combo
